name: Enrapture
descr: Make a **Spellcast Roll** against a target within Close range. On a success, they become temporarily _Enraptured_. While _Enraptured_, a target's attention is fixed on you, narrowing their field of view and drowning out any sound but your voice. Once per rest on a success, you can **mark a Stress** to force the _Enraptured_ target to mark a Stress as well.
